cues.text: In Paulownia Mall's Fountain Square, decorated for Christmas, you and Chihiro walk in side by side among the shoppers, both carrying your bags.
You and Chihiro walk on to look around, and stop together by the fountain.
Chihiro holds out a small handmade gift to you, and you take it.
Chihiro steps in close to your side and stands there, her hands clasped on her bag.
